## Z+ envelope (DEC-P0-015, auto-injected)

This is a Renovate-managed PR. The full Z+ matrices live in
`docs/zplus/ZPLUS_PR_DISCIPLINE.md`; Renovate dep bumps follow the
**reduced discipline** below per the carve-out:

- **Z+ 15-row matrix**: N/A — dep bump only; CI gate enforces ruff + mypy + pyright + pytest 100% coverage.
- **Z+ 7-row resilience matrix**: N/A — no hot-path code touched.
- **Z+ 7-layer audit**: DETECT/VERIFY via CI; PREVENT via this packageRule; AUDIT via Renovate's per-PR commit history; RECOVER via `git revert`; COOLDOWN N/A.
- **4-agent hostile review**: SKIPPED — automated dep bump in trusted range; CI is the gate.
- **Honest envelope**: Renovate trusts `pip install -e ".[dev,data]"` resolves to a green test suite. If CI fails, the PR does NOT auto-merge.
- **Decision ID**: DEC-P0-015 (`docs/MIGRATION.md`) authorizes Renovate auto-merge for non-data-lake CVE patches.

DEC-P0-015 (PR #37) — Z+ security auto-merge carve-out: data-lake trio (polars+duckdb+pyarrow) is EXCLUDED from vulnerabilityAlerts auto-merge to preserve the python-data-lake lock-step group (single CVE patch must not split the ABI-locked trio). All OTHER deps with a vulnerability patch auto-merge after green CI. Placed LAST in packageRules per Agent 1 hot-path review precedence rule. Concurrent-limit:1 prevents racing security PRs from squash-conflicting (Agent 1 MEDIUM finding).
